description: Recap open window, moved rug, and open trap as separate earned facts.

replacements.old:
<COND (,HOUSE-EVENT-DISTURBANCE
           <SET SEEN T>
           <TELL "- Opened routes, the moved rug, or the exposed trap door left visible evidence that the house has been disturbed." CR>)>
replacements.new:
<COND (<FSET? ,KITCHEN-WINDOW ,OPENBIT>
           <SET SEEN T>
           <TELL "- The kitchen window is open." CR>)>
    <COND (,RUG-MOVED
           <SET SEEN T>
           <TELL "- You moved the living-room rug." CR>)>
    <COND (<FSET? ,TRAP-DOOR ,OPENBIT>
           <SET SEEN T>
           <TELL "- The living-room trap door is open." CR>)>
